stories.h: Nvidia and SK Group announce a $500 billion AI initiative with memory supply and HBM development
stories.s: Securing next-gen memory and co-developing HBM could enable larger, faster AI data centers and reshape the supplier landscape for Nvidia.
b: Value: more than $500 billion AI initiative
Partners: Nvidia and SK Group; includes SK Hynix memory-supply partnership
Technology: joint development of high-bandwidth memory (HBM)
Scope: focus on large-scale data centers and plans for massive AI factories
body: Reuters reports that Nvidia and South Korea's SK Group unveiled a more than $500 billion AI initiative spanning large-scale AI data centers.
The package includes a partnership with SK Hynix to secure next-gen memory supply for Nvidia and joint development of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), according to Reuters.
Tom's Hardware adds that the deal is described as a plan to supercharge AI infrastructure with next-gen memory and involves the construction of massive AI factories, per coverage from Tom's Hardware.

Together, the outlets characterize the initiative as a sweeping alliance aimed at securing critical memory technology and expanding capabilities for AI data-center deployments, signaling a high-stakes push to control key hardware supply chains for next-generation AI workloads.
